ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
REFERENCE ARCHIVE
095
Behind the image
69 / Scarlet Column
REFERENCE 5852.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 050
Art direction: Black against saturated red, a single hard light, poised stillness and a clean
floor-length silhouette.
Photorealistic vertical full-length studio fashion portrait of an original adult woman with long,
sleek straight black hair, glossy red matte lips and a poised, direct gaze, one hand resting at her
hip. She wears a black strapless floor-length column dress with a fitted bodice and black patent
stiletto pumps. Saturated seamless red studio backdrop, soft directional key light with gentle
falloff, clean fabric texture, bold red and black palette, minimal high-fashion campaign, no text or
logos.
70 / Navy Ruffle
REFERENCE 5848.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 050
Art direction: Deep navy against pale blue and warm brown, playful ruffles, a plain studio
backdrop and an even, bright light.
Photorealistic vertical full-length fashion lookbook photograph of an original adult woman with
long, loose light-brown hair and soft blue eyes, one hand lifted to her hair and a calm, slightly
distant gaze. She wears a navy textured long-sleeve mini dress with a pale blue Peter Pan collar
and cuffs, a ruffled bodice tied with a long self-tie bow, and a ruffled hem. Dark navy knee-high
socks with grey cuffs, chunky brown leather platform loafers, and a brown leather crossbody bag,
with small silver hoop earrings. Plain light grey seamless studio backdrop, soft even light, navy and
pale blue palette, collegiate romantic styling, no text or logos.
